art_direction: Minimal lateral 2D dark-fantasy pixel art with large readable pixel groups, cold cave blues and violet shadow, amber fire as the only warm accent, clean silhouette-first composition.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: side-view environment and state reference board for a 2D pixel-art game. Primary request: a root-lined cavern camp with a single open wooden Thalestriel wagon at left; show three clearly separated states of the same wagon: cave-damaged with broken wheel and splintered rail, repaired and stationed, and slow travelling with four sick passengers and one humanoid pulling it. Include a compact relic chest inside the wagon, eight simple sick-bed silhouettes in the camp state, repair wood and wheel materials. Style: minimal lateral dark-fantasy pixel art, readable at game distance, cool cave palette with amber fire. Constraints: no horse, no second vehicle, no enclosed bedroom, no map UI, no readable text, no watermark, ground line straight and continuous under every wagon state.
